changelog:
The mod is ported to Minecraft 1.21.1 and NeoForge 21.1. It replaces the archived Forge 1.20.1 version and does not depend on Alex's Caves anymore.

- Fixed the crash when opening the creative menu, the shell was registered for the search tab and added to the tab of the mod as well, so it ended up in the tab twice.
- Fixed the tooltip of the nuclear shell, it used the translation keys of the old mod id.
- Fixed the ritchiesprojectilelib:precise_motion tag, it pointed to a block instead of the projectile entity.
- Removed invalid munition_properties files that referenced a non existing entity type.
- The crater and the mushroom cloud are now spread over several ticks, the crater is dug from the centre outwards and the cloud is a rising column that is visible from far away.
- Fluids, bedrock and other unbreakable blocks are no longer deleted by the blast.
- The /nuke command no longer sends a broken message and its radius is limited to a safe value.
- Added the missing dependencies on Create: Big Cannons and Ritchie's Projectile Library.
- Replaced the placeholder config with real options for blast radius, damage, radiation, crater speed and screen shake.
- Removed the leftovers of the canceled reactor and uranium features.
